title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD NAMES THE BIG SCREEN AND BELT FIXES
why: The card was stamped v18.84 and the stamp may not trail the build by more than 0.15. Its new second line names the 4K scaling of the backpack, Undercroft text and run card, the belt drag fixes and the gradual Blotter.
now: The what is new card names the big screen and belt fixes.

edits.anchor: 'THIS IS AN ALPHA. Things will break. When something does, the game writes it into your run report and tells you so; that report is how it gets fixed.',
edits.replacement:
'THIS IS AN ALPHA. Things will break. When something does, the game writes it into your run report and tells you so; that report is how it gets fixed.',
  'BIGGER ON A BIG SCREEN, AND THE BELT FIXED. At 4K the backpack, the Undercroft text and the run card grow with the screen. A gun on key 8 drags onto key 1, and dragging one gun key onto the other swaps them. Blotter comes on gradually.',
